# Demo 1 input/output, generated from its 3x3 compartment pattern.
def grid22():
 g=[[0]*22 for _ in range(22)]
 for r in (3,7,11,15,19): g[r]=[8]*22
 for c in (3,7,11,15,19):
  for r in range(22): g[r][c]=8
 g[1][5]=2; g[17][5]=2; g[9][1]=3; g[9][17]=3
 return g
def exp22():
 g=grid22()
 # fill 2 in row-tile col 1, tile rows 0..4
 for r in list(range(0,3))+list(range(4,7))+list(range(8,11))+list(range(12,15))+list(range(16,19)):
  for c in range(4,7): g[r][c]=2
 # fill 3 across tile row 2, tile cols 0..4; overlap tile (2,1) is 6
 for r in range(8,11):
  for c in list(range(0,3))+list(range(4,7))+list(range(8,11))+list(range(12,15))+list(range(16,19)):
   g[r][c]=6 if 4<=c<=6 else 3
 return g
assert m.transform(grid22()) == exp22(), 'demo mismatch'
